item.title: Labour minister denies Burnham ‘too blokey’ – UK politics live
item.summary: Home Office minister Anna Turley says PM is ‘authentic’ and praises video of him discussing bar snacks with John Healey Scottish Labour has “turned to rubble”, one of the party’s leadership contenders has claimed. Monica Lennon still does not have enough support to secure a spot on the ballot to take on MSPs Michael Marra and Joe Fagan in the contest to succeed Anas Sarwar. Continue reading...
